quests.instruction: Which family member is too little to go to school yet?
quests.question: Baby
quests.hint: This family member is the youngest one in the house.
quests.explanation: Baby is too little to go to school since they are the youngest family member.
quests.funFact: Babies learn new things every single day, even before they can talk!

quests.instruction: Which family member is your father's wife?
quests.question: Mother
quests.hint: Think about who you might call 'Mom' or 'Mommy' at home.
quests.explanation: Mother is the woman who is married to your father and is one of your two parents.
quests.funFact: In many languages around the world, children call their mother a name that starts with the sound 'ma'!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a male sibling in your family?
quests.question: Brother
quests.hint: This is a boy who shares your parents.
quests.explanation: Brother is the word for a male sibling in your family.
quests.funFact: In some families, a brother might have several sisters and no other brothers at all!

quests.instruction: Which family member is your mother's husband?
quests.question: Father
quests.hint: Think about who you might call 'Dad' or 'Daddy' at home.
quests.explanation: Father is the man who is married to your mother and is one of your two parents.
quests.funFact: Many countries celebrate a special holiday just to celebrate fathers, too!

quests.instruction: Which family member is always a girl, whether older or younger than you, who shares your parents?
quests.question: Sister
quests.hint: Think about a girl who is your own sibling.
quests.explanation: Sister can be older or younger than you, but she always shares the same parents as you.
quests.funFact: Whether older or younger, sisters often look out for each other!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the youngest person in the family and cannot walk or talk yet?
quests.question: Baby
quests.hint: This family member sleeps a lot and drinks from a bottle.
quests.explanation: Baby is the youngest member of the family who cannot walk or talk yet.
quests.funFact: Babies usually say their very first word around their first birthday!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the woman who is your parent, not your sister?
quests.question: Mother
quests.hint: She is married to your father.
quests.explanation: Mother is your parent and a woman, different from your sister, who is your own age group.
quests.funFact: A mother and her child often share similar smiles or features!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a boy who grew up in the same house as you, with the same parents?
quests.question: Brother
quests.hint: He is your own age group, not a parent.
quests.explanation: Brother is a boy who grew up with you, sharing the same parents and home.
quests.funFact: Growing up in the same home often means brothers share tons of inside jokes!

quests.instruction: In a family tree, which family member is the man connected right above you as your parent?
quests.question: Father
quests.hint: He is married to your mother and is one of your two parents.
quests.explanation: Father is the man parent connected directly above you on a family tree.
quests.funFact: On a family tree, parents are usually drawn on the branch right above their children!

quests.instruction: Which family member might you call your 'sis' for short?
quests.question: Sister
quests.hint: She is a girl who shares your parents.
quests.explanation: Sister is sometimes called 'sis' for short by her siblings.
quests.funFact: The word 'sis' is a friendly nickname used in many English-speaking families!

quests.instruction: Which family member cries to let everyone know they are hungry or tired?
quests.question: Baby
quests.hint: This family member cannot use words yet.
quests.explanation: Baby cries to communicate their needs since they cannot use words yet.
quests.funFact: Babies have different cries for different needs, like hunger or feeling sleepy!

quests.instruction: Which family member is one of your two parents and also a woman?
quests.question: Mother
quests.hint: She is your father's wife.
quests.explanation: Mother is one of your two parents and is a woman.
quests.funFact: Families come in many shapes, but everyone has a mother who gave birth to them!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a boy who has the very same parents as you?
quests.question: Brother
quests.hint: He is close to your own age, not a parent.
quests.explanation: Brother is a boy who shares the same parents as you.
quests.funFact: Brothers often share family traits, like the same color hair or the same laugh!

quests.instruction: Which family member is your mother's partner in taking care of you?
quests.question: Father
quests.hint: He is a man, and together with your mother, he is one of your two parents.
quests.explanation: Father works together with mother to take care of you as one of your two parents.
quests.funFact: Fathers often enjoy teaching their children new games and skills!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a girl who has the very same parents as you?
quests.question: Sister
quests.hint: She is close to your own age, not a parent.
quests.explanation: Sister is a girl who shares the same parents as you.
quests.funFact: Sisters often share family traits, like the same color eyes or the same smile!

quests.instruction: Which family member giggles and coos instead of speaking in full sentences?
quests.question: Baby
quests.hint: This family member is still learning their very first sounds and words.
quests.explanation: Baby giggles and coos while they are still learning their first sounds and words.
quests.funFact: Babies often start babbling sounds like 'ba-ba' or 'da-da' before saying real words!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a grown woman who takes care of you as your parent, alongside your father?
quests.question: Mother
quests.hint: This is the person you might call 'Mama'.
quests.explanation: Mother takes care of you as your parent, together with your father.
quests.funFact: Mothers often know just the right way to comfort you when you don't feel well!

quests.instruction: Which family member could be older or younger than you, but always shares your parents?
quests.question: Brother
quests.hint: This family member is a boy.
quests.explanation: Brother can be older or younger than you, but he always shares the same parents as you.
quests.funFact: Whether older or younger, brothers often look out for each other!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a grown man who takes care of you as your parent, alongside your mother?
quests.question: Father
quests.hint: This is the person you might call 'Papa'.
quests.explanation: Father takes care of you as your parent, together with your mother.
quests.funFact: Fathers often love telling their favorite childhood stories to their kids!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a female sibling in your family?
quests.question: Sister
quests.hint: This is a girl who shares your parents.
quests.explanation: Sister is the word for a female sibling in your family.
quests.funFact: The word 'sibling' means a brother or a sister — anyone who shares your parents!

quests.instruction: Which family member takes naps several times throughout the day?
quests.question: Baby
quests.hint: This family member is very young and needs lots of rest.
quests.explanation: Baby takes several naps a day since young babies need lots of rest to grow.
quests.funFact: Babies can sleep up to sixteen hours a day when they are very small!

quests.instruction: In a family tree, which family member is the woman connected right above you as your parent?
quests.question: Mother
quests.hint: She is married to your father and is one of your two parents.
quests.explanation: Mother is the woman parent connected directly above you on a family tree.
quests.funFact: A family tree is a fun drawing that shows how everyone in a family is connected!

quests.instruction: Which family member might you call your 'bro' for short?
quests.question: Brother
quests.hint: He is a boy who shares your parents.
quests.explanation: Brother is sometimes called 'bro' for short by his siblings.
quests.funFact: The word 'bro' is a friendly nickname used in many English-speaking families!

quests.instruction: Which family member do many children call 'Dad' or 'Daddy'?
quests.question: Father
quests.hint: This person is a grown man who is one of your two parents.
quests.explanation: Father is the name many children use for the man who is one of their two parents.
quests.funFact: In many families, children learn to say 'Dad' as one of their very first words!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a daughter of your mother and father, other than you?
quests.question: Sister
quests.hint: This family member is a girl in your own generation.
quests.explanation: Sister is a daughter of your mother and father, just like you but a different person.
quests.funFact: Many sisters grow up sharing a bedroom and lots of favorite memories!

quests.instruction: Which family member sleeps in a crib and needs to be carried everywhere?
quests.question: Baby
quests.hint: This family member is the newest, smallest one in the family.
quests.explanation: Baby sleeps in a crib and needs to be carried since they cannot walk yet.
quests.funFact: Babies grow so fast that they often need new clothes every few months!

quests.instruction: Which family member carried you inside her before you were born?
quests.question: Mother
quests.hint: This family member is a woman, and she is one of your two parents.
quests.explanation: Your mother carried you before you were born and is one of your two parents.
quests.funFact: Babies can hear their mother's voice even before they are born!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a boy who plays and grows up alongside you in the same family?
quests.question: Brother
quests.hint: He is your own age group, sharing your parents.
quests.explanation: Brother is a boy who plays and grows up alongside you, sharing your parents.
quests.funFact: Brothers often become teammates for backyard games and playful competitions!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the male parent in your family?
quests.question: Father
quests.hint: Think about who you might call 'Dad' at home.
quests.explanation: Father is the male parent in your family.
quests.funFact: The word for 'father' sounds a little bit similar in many languages, like 'papa' or 'baba'!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a girl your parents call 'their daughter', just like you might be their son or another daughter?
quests.question: Sister
quests.hint: She shares the very same mom and dad as you.
quests.explanation: Sister is a girl your parents also call their daughter, sharing the same family as you.
quests.funFact: Parents often say having more than one child means their kids can grow up as best friends!
